propositions: Per-criterion fan-out in recovery is replaced with batched successor runs that verify unbanked criteria in groups (batch cap tuned to model class slot: standard/frontier/trivial), each successor inheriting remaining request budget from an exhausted primary.

Criterion verdicts are banked incrementally during the primary run using record_criterion_verdict tool (with 3000-char evidence cap and truncated flag), keyed by deterministic criterion_id (c<index>-<sha256 hash>), so verified work survives primary exhaustion and successors resume with unverified remainder only.

Request budget pool is criteria-scaled (N = ceil(verify_step_floor(c)/2) where floor = clamp(8*c, 48, 480)) rather than flat, reducing oversized budgets that fuel runaway verification loops and manufactured recovery cases.

Finalizer always emits full-coverage verdict (banked criteria scored from evidence; unbanked as met=false placeholders) and includes deterministic no-LLM fallback on repeated failure, eliminating verdict-less outcomes and the --force-close trap.
Read-file memoization is normalized by path to cache whole-file content once and slice all ranges from cache, collapsing 77% re-read waste measured in f6fc verification (48 calls / 11 files).
Automatic prompt-cache (cache_settings_for arms in capabilities.py) reuses system-prompt + tool-definition prefix across primary and successor runs, amortizing re-sent ticket context cost.
